title: Bar Drop Strawberry Ice Pop 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Strawberry Ice Pop by Drop is a nostalgic treat that recreates the taste of a classic frozen lolly. It features an intensified strawberry syrup flavour, sweet and vibrant, finished with a cooling ice effect that mimics the sensation of a frozen fruit treat on a hot day. Formulated with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this blend ensures the sweet strawberry notes are delivered with high-definition clarity. Perfect for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vaping, it offers a smooth throat hit via its nicotine salt formula, available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
